binding: public claims about this certificate are governed by the enclosed claim-language kit

classes.name: payment certificate
classes.attests: A settled payment, and nothing beyond it: which Entitlement the organisation bought, the period and the scope it covers, and the revenue band the payer self-certified. It is issued after the payment settles against a recorded transaction, never in anticipation of one, and it carries no figure or claim about impact — none exists before the first disbursed ledger row.

variants.label: holds a paid Entitlement of the Purpose Source Network
variants.precondition: a settled Purpose Fee payment attributable to the named organisation

variants.label: funded an Entitlement for another organisation
variants.precondition: a settled payment made on another organisation's behalf through the gift flow, which does not exist at this phase

variants.label: holds a waiver and funded the movement separately
variants.precondition: a granted waiver plus a settled top-up or a documented donation; neither lane exists at this phase, and without the funding a waived organisation gets a status certificate only
variants.notBefore: P-M3, with the top-up and donation lanes

variants.label: funded the movement through the donate-direct lane
variants.precondition: a documented donation through the donate-direct lane, which does not exist at this phase; whether this stays a variant of this class or becomes its own is an open question in the record

permitted: holds a {Entitlement kind} of the Purpose Source Network; Purpose Fee amount: {amount as settled}; period: {period}; categories: {categories}
states the designation of the variant the certificate carries, exactly as this policy records it
states the self-certified revenue band the certificate prints
names the scope the certificate records: the repositories of a Project Entitlement, the portfolio, or every registered repository for a Pass
points a reader at the verification page so the claim can be checked independently
prohibited: the Purpose Fee described as a donation, or the payer described as a donor, on the paid lane
no figure or claim about impact of any kind, and no claimed outcome the published ledger does not show
any use of the marks implying endorsement, partnership, certification of the holder's products, or membership
any verification address other than the one the certificate prints

classes.name: status certificate
classes.attests: A status this movement has already recorded, and only that: a granted waiver, a self-certified registration below the licence threshold, or coverage through a gifted Pass. It attests no payment, because none was made under it, and it carries no amount field at all.

variants.label: Purpose Source Licensed Organization — waiver
variants.precondition: a granted waiver recorded in the published waiver registry. The registry exists and is correctly empty: no waiver can be granted before a repository administrator can prove administrative control, so none has been granted and no waiver certificate exists yet

variants.label: Purpose Source Licensed Organization — under threshold
variants.precondition: a recorded threshold registration — the organisation's own self-certification, on one binding tick, with no audit right anywhere in the terms. The surface that records it is not built at this phase, so none is recorded yet

variants.label: covered via gifted Pass
variants.precondition: a redeemed gifted Pass, which requires the gift flow

permitted: states the designation of the variant the certificate carries, exactly as this policy records it
states the period the recorded status covers
states that the organisation's use of the covered repositories is licensed for that period
points a reader at the verification page so the status can be checked independently
prohibited: every prohibition on the payment class's list, without exception
any supporter, funder or generosity phrasing: nothing was funded under this certificate
any amount, in any currency: an unfunded class has no amount field to quote
no figure or claim about impact of any kind, which for a waived organisation would be false rather than merely vague
any verification address other than the one the certificate prints

notIssuable.why: It needs a claimed account, the subject's own certificate opt-in, and an attribution record to attest. None of the three exists at this phase, and a certificate about a person is never issued without that person's opt-in.

notIssuable.notBefore: P-M3, with the claim flow; the impact variant additionally not before the project's own first ledger row
notIssuable.why: The registration variant needs a proven project steward, which the claim flow establishes. The impact variant needs at least one ledger row for that project, and no ledger row exists.
The top-up lane is a later phase in its entirety: there is no way to buy a multiplier, so there is no settled payment for one to attest.

notIssuable.class: any certificate, figure or claim about impact
notIssuable.notBefore: after the first disbursed ledger row exists — a later phase than this one
notIssuable.why: Nothing has been disbursed, so there is nothing to attest and no figure to print. The absence is structural rather than remembered: the frozen type enum has no token for it, and the operator signing tool has no code path that could write such a field.
